info.title: KPK Wellness recipe publishing
info.description: Publishes a recipe to kpk.associates. The recipes page reads the repository at page load, so a successful call puts the recipe live immediately.

200.description: The category folders the site displays

post.summary: Create or update a recipe on the live site
post.description: Writes the recipe to content/recetas/<categoria>/<id>.md on the main branch. The server derives the file path from categoria and id (or from the title when id is omitted); you never send a path. Publishing an id that already exists updates that recipe.

titulo.description: Recipe title in Spanish, e.g. 'Flan de coco'. Max 120 characters.

categoria.description: Category folder. Only these four are displayed by the site.

id.description: Optional slug, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. 'flan-de-coco'. Derived from the title when omitted. Reuse an existing id to update that recipe.

markdown.description: The complete recipe markdown as PLAIN TEXT (not base64), following the documented recipe format: frontmatter block, then a '# Title' heading, then the unaccented headings Titulo, Utensilios, Ingredientes, Preparacion, Macros por persona (estimado) and Costeo aproximado. If the frontmatter is missing, the server adds id and categoria.

400.description: Missing or invalid field; the error says which

503.description: Agent publishing is not enabled on the server

actualizada.description: true when an existing recipe was overwritten

url.description: Where the recipe is now visible

agentToken.description: The agent token (AGENT_TOKEN on the server). Configure it as the Action's authentication value: Authentication type 'API Key', Auth Type 'Bearer'. Never paste it into the schema or the GPT instructions.
